reason: The policy requires: 'An order can only be exchanged if its status is 'delivered', and you should check its status before taking the action. In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all items to be exchanged.' and 'Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.' The assistant did not remind the user to confirm they provided all items to be exchanged, nor did it list the full action details (such as price difference) and get explicit user confirmation prior to calling exchange_delivered_order_items. Additionally, an earlier message made two simultaneous tool calls, violating 'You should at most make one tool call at a time'.
